description: Reference ristretto255 decoding and k*B results computed by libsodium 1.0.18 (php:8.2-cli, sodium_crypto_core_ristretto255_is_valid_point and sodium_crypto_scalarmult_ristretto255). "libsodiumValid" is the raw libsodium answer; "valid" is what RFC 9496 requires: libsodium 1.0.18 accepts the identity and encodings with bit 255 set (it masks that bit), both of which must be rejected.
